UPDATE project_tidy_jobs SET status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = NOW(), lease_token = lease_token + 1, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_code = 'CANCELLED', error_message = #{reason} WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
